issue.title: gateway: server-managed tools (web_search/web_fetch) silently dropped on translated routes — 200 OK, no error or capability signal
issue.body:
## Summary

When a request carries provider-hosted (server-managed) tool declarations — e.g. Anthropic `web_search_20260209` / `web_fetch_20250910` on `/v1/messages`, or OpenAI `{type:"web_search"}` on `/v1/responses` — magpie forwards them correctly when the upstream protocol supports them, but **silently drops them** when the resolved upstream is OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible. The request returns 200, the model answers as if it has no tools, and nothing in the response or logs marks the drop.

The dangerous consequence: the model cannot distinguish "no tool configured" from "tool was stripped", so it answers anyway — including confidently hallucinated facts (observed: `swe-2` reported today's date as **May 22, 2026** when it was actually October 21).

## Environment

magpie 0.1.1312 (macOS), gateway at `127.0.0.1:3425`. Verified by direct SSE probing of the local gateway.

## Reproduction

```bash
# Server-managed tool silently dropped (upstream = openai-compatible plugin provider)
curl -N http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/messages \
  -H "x-api-key: $MAGPIE_KEY" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
  -d '{
    "model": "devin/claude-fable-5-1",
    "max_tokens": 1024, "stream": true,
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"What is today'"'"'s date? Search the web."}],
    "tools": [{"type":"web_search_20260209","name":"web_search","max_uses":5}]
  }'
# -> streams only a `text` block; model replies "I don't have the ability to search the web"
```

Control — a normal function tool on the same route works fine (model emits `tool_use`), so tool *forwarding* is not broken in general:

```bash
# same body but tools: [{"name":"get_weather", ...}], tool_choice forced
# -> devin/claude-fable-5-1, devin/swe-2, deepseek/deepseek-flash all emit tool_use blocks
```

## Measured behavior matrix

| Upstream provider | Upstream protocol | Function tools | `web_search_*` | `web_fetch_*` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `codex` (Codex OAuth) | Responses | — | ✅ full `web_search_call` lifecycle | n/a |
| `deepseek` → `api.deepseek.com/anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | ✅ | ✅ real `server_tool_use` + `web_search_tool_result` | ❌ upstream 422 (unsupported tool type — correctly surfaces an error!) |
| `right-code` → `rightapi.ai` | Anthropic Messages (relay) | ✅ | ❌ dropped (relay-side, both `20250305` and `20260209`) | ✅ `20250910` and `20260309` both work |
| `devin` plugin → `server.codeium.com/devin/v1` | OpenAI Chat Completions | ✅ | ❌ silently dropped | ❌ silently dropped |
| `opencode-zen-free` plugin → `opencode.ai/inference/v1` | OpenAI Chat Completions | — | ❌ silently dropped (both `/v1/messages` and `/v1/responses`) | ❌ silently dropped |

Two observations worth noting:

- The DeepSeek 422 response (`unknown variant 'web_fetch_20250910'`) reached the client verbatim — proof that on Anthropic-routed providers magpie forwards the `tools` array unchanged, and proof that **surfacing an upstream error works** when the upstream produces one.
- The same `/v1/messages` entry point therefore behaves completely differently per model — invisible to clients. A Claude-named model served over an openai-compatible upstream cannot carry Anthropic-native tools, but nothing tells the client that.

## Expected behavior

Any of the following would fix the silent-degradation problem (my preference: 1 + 3):

1. **Fail or warn on stripped tools.** When translation to the upstream protocol drops entries from `tools`, either reject with a 4xx naming the dropped tool types, or annotate the response (metadata field / SSE event / synthetic `tool_result` error block). A silent 200 that removes capabilities is the worst possible signal.
2. **Echo dropped entries back** in the response (e.g. an `x-magpie-stripped-tools` header or a `stripped_tools` field) so clients can detect degradation without deep-parsing the stream.
3. **Expose capability metadata in `/v1/models`** — e.g. a `server_tools: ["web_search","web_fetch"]` list per model — so agent harnesses can avoid configuring tools that can never execute.

## Why it matters

Agent CLIs now reach provider-native web tools through this gateway (pi extensions, Claude Code-style flows, Grok X search per #3153). A client that sends `web_search` and gets a clean 200 with the tool silently removed gets not just a worse answer — it gets a *confidently wrong* one, with no way to detect that the tool never ran. The fix doesn't require implementing hosted search where the upstream lacks it; it only requires making the drop visible.

comments.body:
The server tools were dropped at parse time: a request's `tools` were read into a single boolean (`Request.WebSearch`) and the types the client offered were thrown away, so a translated request that had no wire for `web_fetch_20250910`, or no upstream and no searcher to answer a `web_search_20260209`, was built without them and the reply said nothing.

The branch keeps the offered types (`Request.ServerTools`, filled by the Messages, Chat, Responses and Gemini parsers) and names each one the request isn't sent in `X-Magpie-Tools-Dropped`, comma-separated, once each: `web_search_20260209`, `web_fetch_20250910`, Codex's `web_search`, a Gemini client's `googleSearch`. A web search the upstream or magpie's own searcher answers is not named, and a relayed body keeps its tools and names nothing. `docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md` says so under "Constraints and failure behavior".

[fix/3206-gateway-server-managed-tools-web](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3206-gateway-server-managed-tools-web), commit b9d5e58c864d15d07c048c8b0e6ac8c1bf942012.

Run: `TestServerToolsDroppedAreNamed` fails on the unmodified code with an empty header (`X-Magpie-Tools-Dropped = "", want "web_search_20260209"`, and the same for the other five cases) and passes now; `go build ./...` and `go vet ./internal/gateway/` are clean. `go test ./internal/gateway/ -count=1` (the whole package) was not completed.

This is a fork branch, ready for review; it makes no claim on the issue's ownership.

issue.title: [Bug] `web_search_20250305`: text 块始终没有 `citations[]`，依赖 `cited_text` 的客户端只能拿到 url+title（DSH 的 web_search 因此「搜到了但没有内容」）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 环境

- magpie **0.1.1364**（macOS，App 版，网关 `127.0.0.1:3425`）
- DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2**，profile `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`
- DSH 的搜索插件 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`（provider id `deepseek-official`）被路由到 magpie：
  ```yaml
  - id: web-search-deepseek
    name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek"
    config:
      apiKeyEnv: MAGPIE_GATEWAY_KEY
      baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1"
      model: "auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
  ```

## 现象

DSH 里每一次 `web_search` 都只返回**标题 + 链接**，没有任何摘要/正文，用户侧表现为「联网搜索不可用」。

网关这条链其实是**成功**的：请求 200，`server_tool_use` 和 `web_search_tool_result` 都在，结果条目也有（6～10 条）。问题在于**响应里的 `text` 块 `citations` 恒为空数组** —— 而 `citations[].cited_text` 是 Anthropic 协议下唯一承载摘要摘录的字段（官方文档：*Citations are always enabled for web search*；`web_search_result_location` 含 `url` / `title` / `encrypted_index` / `cited_text`）。

下游 DSH 的 `mapAnthropicResponse()` 正是只用 `citations[].cited_text` 来生成 `snippet`：

```js
function citationSnippets(blocks) {
  const map = new Map();
  for (const block of blocks) {
    if (block.type !== "text") continue;
    for (const cite of block.citations ?? [])
      if (cite.url && cite.cited_text && !map.has(cite.url)) map.set(cite.url, cite.cited_text);
  }
  return map;
}
```

`citations` 为空 ⇒ `sources` 里每条只剩 `url` + `title` ⇒ 模型拿到的信息量为零。

## 复现（curl 直打网关，100% 复现）

```bash
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/messages \
  -H "x-api-key: $MAGPIE_GATEWAY_KEY" \
  -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Perform a web search for the query: 江苏智库智能科技有限公司 招聘"}]}],
    "tools": [{"type":"web_search_20250305","name":"web_search","max_uses":5}],
    "thinking": {"type":"disabled"}
  }'
```

（请求体与 DSH 插件发出的完全一致，见 DSH 会话日志 `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` 事件。）

## 实测结果矩阵

两条**不同上游**的路由都一样，说明不是某一个中转的怪癖：

| `model` 入参 | 实际路由到 | `web_search_tool_result` 条目 | `text` 块长度 | `citations` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `raccoon/sn-deepseek-v4-1-flash` | 6 | 1663 字符 | **0** |
| `deepseek/deepseek-flash` | `deepseek/deepseek-flash` | 10 | 1933 字符 | **0** |

两条路由的 `web_search_result` 条目字段均为：
`['type','title','url','encrypted_content','page_age']` —— **没有** `snippet`/`text`/`cited_text` 之类的摘录字段。

响应块序列（第一条路由）：

```
[thinking]
[server_tool_use]                 ← 模型确实发起了搜索
[web_search_tool_result] items=6
[thinking]
[text] len=1663 citations=0       ← 有正文，但没有 citations
```

> 注意到 `web_search_result` 条目带 `encrypted_content`，这是**原生透传**的特征（magpie 没有走自己的代搜管线，而是把工具转发给上游的 Anthropic 兼容端点）。

## 期望

按 Anthropic 规范，web search 的 `text` 块应当带 `citations[]`，每项形如：

```json
{
  "type": "web_search_result_location",
  "url": "https://...",
  "title": "...",
  "encrypted_index": "...",
  "cited_text": "被引用的最多 150 字符原文"
}
```

## 影响面（不只影响 DSH）

任何按 Anthropic 规范从 `citations[].cited_text` 取摘要的 Messages 客户端都会退化成「只有标题」。

而 DSH 的情况更糟：它的 `mapAnthropicResponse()` **只**用 `web_search_tool_result` + citations 组装 `sources`，那段 1663/1933 字符的 `text` 正文被**整个丢弃**，所以用户最终连"模型已经搜到了什么"都看不到。

## 建议修法（按改动量排序）

1. **在转译层补 `citations`**：当上游返回的 `text` 块没有 citations、但同响应里有 `web_search_tool_result` 时，为 `sources` 里的条目合成一个最小 `web_search_result_location`（`url` + `title` + 由 `page_age`/标题生成的 `cited_text` 占位）。这样至少让下游不空手。
2. **让代搜管线产出 citations**：magpie 自己的 searcher（#669 修好的那条路）本来就自己构造 `web_search_tool_result`，可以顺带填充 `cited_text`（searcher 有正文，`cited_text` 截 150 字符即可，完全在 magpie 能力范围内）。
3. **暴露能力信号**：若上游确实无法提供 citations，至少让客户端能判断「这次搜索结果没有摘要」，而不是静默返回一堆裸 URL。
4. 顺带：`searchFirst` 当前是 `api`，但这次实际仍是转发到上游 provider（路由日志 `provider: commandcode`）。如果代搜能提供更完整的结果+citations，建议在客户端依赖 citations 时优先走代搜。

## 相关

- #3206 —— server-managed tools 在翻译路由上被**整体丢弃**（本条不同：工具正常执行，只是 citations 缺失）
- #3047 —— 按模型声明原生 web_search 能力
- #669 —— 代搜回传空 `web_search_tool_result.content`（已修，同类"客户端表现为搜索不可用"）
- #2726 —— dsh 的 `web-search-deepseek` 被改写到网关
- #2044 —— 在翻译后的 Responses 回复里保留 web search 结果

## 附：DSH 侧可互补的一处

DSH 的 `mapAnthropicResponse()` 完全不读 `text` 块。即使 magpie 这次补齐了 citations，那段真正的正文仍然会被丢弃。DSH 侧可以加个兜底：citations 为空时，至少把 `text` 正文作为 `content` 返回。这部分属于 DSH 的改动，不是 magpie 的问题，仅作上下文说明。

issue.title: feat: preserve web search results in translated Responses replies

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Responses clients can receive a successful answer from Magpie's delegated web search without receiving any structured record that the search ran. Feature request: preserve completed searches and their source URLs in both streamed and non-streamed Responses replies, so clients can verify that web search ran.

## Context and reproduction

This was found while connecting bqAgent's `web_search` tool to Magpie. The conversation uses `/v1/responses`, including when its selected model is DeepSeek or another model that relies on Magpie's configured search provider. The client sends a separate search request such as:

```json
{
  "model": "provider/model-without-native-search",
  "input": "Search the web for nerdctl CDI support and cite the release notes.",
  "tools": [{"type": "web_search"}],
  "include": ["web_search_call.action.sources"],
  "stream": true
}
```

With a search provider configured, Magpie can execute the search, feed its results back to the conversation model, and finish its answer. However, on base `e297a8ab`:

- `searchRounds` emits `KSearch`, and the collector preserves a `Search` part with its query and hits.
- `responsesEncoder.event` has no `KSearch` case, and `renderResponses` has no `Search` case. The client receives the answer text but loses the search item and its sources.
- A client that requires an actual search record plus source URLs consequently reports “no verifiable web search results”, even though search ran upstream.

Anthropic output already serializes these internal records as `server_tool_use` / `web_search_tool_result`. This explains why the client's workaround sends just the search subrequest to `/v1/messages`, while keeping its main conversation on Responses. It is ordinary server-side provider search, not Magpie's search MCP.

## Proposed feature

- Serialize each existing search record as a completed `web_search_call` with a `ws_` ID, `action.type: "search"`, the query, and `action.sources` containing the nonempty source URLs. Supply both legacy `query` and current `queries`.
- For SSE, emit `response.output_item.added`, `response.web_search_call.completed`, and `response.output_item.done`, retaining the identical item in the terminal response's `output`. Keep item indexes and event sequence numbers consistent around text and client tool calls.
- Share the item conversion with the JSON renderer. Keep an actual search with no hits as an empty source list; plain text or an upstream error creates no search record.
- Update the [gateway routing reference](https://github.com/BussanQ/magpie/blob/codex/responses-search-results/docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md#search-results-in-translated-responses-replies).

The wire format follows the official [web search output documentation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/tools-web-search) and [search completion event](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses/streaming-events#response-web-search-call-completed). `KSearch` arrives after execution, so this does not fabricate earlier progress events or text citation offsets. Source URLs are carried in the search action; answer annotations remain unchanged.

This is an output-conversion fix for existing `KSearch` / `Search` records. Upstream decoders, provider selection, native Responses passthrough, search limits, `tool_choice`, and timeouts are unchanged. In particular, the separately observed thinking-mode rejection of forced `tool_choice` and the client's 90-second timeout are separate issues, outside the scope of this feature request.

## Verification

Tests run under a temporary HOME with `GOPATH`, `GOMODCACHE`, and `GOCACHE` pinned before changing the child process environment. They use in-memory events and local fake providers, without live credentials or vendor requests.

**Regression demonstrated against base `e297a8ab`:** restored the unmodified `responses.go` while retaining the new tests and ran:

```sh
go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway -run '^(TestResponsesSearch.*|TestWebSearchForAModelThatCannot)$' -count=1
```

It failed in both JSON and SSE cases with `search output lost or reordered` and `delegated search missing from Responses output`. The decoded-search and search-followed-by-error cases also failed because their search item was absent. The fixed implementation was then restored.

**Passing checks:**

```sh
go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway -run '^(TestResponsesSearch.*|TestWebSearchForAModelThatCannot|TestSearchToldAsAnthropics|TestWebSearchAskedOfEachAPI|TestAnthropicServerToolLeftOut|TestParallelToolCallIDs|TestResponsesStreamToolThenHiddenThinking)$' -count=1
go test -tags nogui -race ./internal/gateway -run '^(TestResponsesSearch.*|TestWebSearchForAModelThatCannot|TestSearchToldAsAnthropics|TestWebSearchAskedOfEachAPI|TestAnthropicServerToolLeftOut|TestParallelToolCallIDs|TestResponsesStreamToolThenHiddenThinking)$' -count=1
git diff --check
gofmt -l internal/gateway/responses.go internal/gateway/responses_search_test.go internal/gateway/search_test.go
```

Coverage includes delegated search through the Responses handler with a fake non-searching model and a separate search provider; JSON/SSE output; consecutive searches; empty results and missing URLs; ID/index/sequence consistency; terminal output; text and client-tool preservation; usage; decoded native search with an empty terminal output; no fabricated search for ordinary text or errors; and a completed search followed by a failed response.

Not run: the full repository suite, repository-wide vet/builds or cross-platform checks, GUI checks, and live-provider validation. The running Magpie service and bqAgent checkout were not modified by this implementation work.

## Reference implementation

A tested implementation is available in [this branch](https://github.com/BussanQ/magpie/tree/codex/responses-search-results), commit [b1a4e7b](https://github.com/BussanQ/magpie/commit/b1a4e7b3c1025cc4e69c977175b31c0bdccc9244). PR creation through the current account was denied, so this is submitted as a feature request for maintainer consideration.

issue.title: gateway: Claude subscription replies omit usage.server_tool_use.web_search_requests, so searches can't be billed downstream

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
v0.1.2159; unchanged in v0.1.3099.

**Steps**: `POST /v1/messages`, model `claude/claude-haiku-5-5`, `tools: [{"type":"web_search_20250305","name":"web_search","max_uses":2}]`.

**Actual**: the content has 2 `server_tool_use` + `web_search_tool_result` pairs, but `usage` has no `server_tool_use`:

```json
{"input_tokens":4,"output_tokens":632,"cache_read_input_tokens":4503,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5062}
```

**Expected**: `usage.server_tool_use.web_search_requests: 2`, as Anthropic's API reports it. Gateways in front of magpie (e.g. new-api) bill web search from that field, so every search on this route goes unbilled. magpie already counts these searches (`searchTally`, `search_native.go`), but only for its own request log; the Anthropic encoder never writes the count into the reply's usage.

Related: #3206.

issue.title: [Bug] Responses→Chat：无 Claude 签名的 web_search_call 历史被静默删除（v0.1.3327）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题摘要

Magpie **v0.1.3327** 将 Responses 会话转换为 Chat Completions 请求时，会静默删除普通 `web_search_call` 历史中的查询词和来源 URL；只有带符合条件的 Claude signed thinking 的搜索才走历史重建分支。

这与「搜索未执行」或「输出流重复拼接」不同：一次搜索可能已执行、结果也已用于当前请求，但客户端把搜索记录作为下一次 Responses 的 input 传回来时，这些现存历史信息被过滤，上游模型无法读取。

实际使用中遇到 agent 长会话反复搜索、反复说“复核”。**历史丢失已复现，但尚未通过修复前后对照证明它是所有重复生成的唯一原因。**

## 环境与范围

- macOS Apple Silicon，Magpie desktop/portable **0.1.3327**。
- 客户端 Codex，调用 `/v1/responses`。
- 自定义供应商同时配置 Chat/Responses URL；`baseAPI=responses`，目标单模型 API 设置为 `chat`。
- 实际链路：Codex → Magpie Responses→Chat → CPA + WorkBuddy 插件 → `blind-model-g`。
- 同一安装二进制的隔离副本 + 本机 mock Chat 上游也可复现，不需要 WorkBuddy、CPA 或真实账号。隔离副本没有改生产配置。
- 本报告是上述版本的实测。另只读检查了 main `c6bdc172a01e1eb8713c596e33e1ef703eb9b4ee`，同一删除分支仍存在；**没有声称对 main 二进制做过实测**。

## 最小合成复现

在隔离 portable 目录配置一个能记录 POST JSON 并返回标准 Chat SSE 的本机 mock 上游。供应商与设置示意（端口仅为例子）：

```json
{
  "providers": [{
    "id": "cpa",
    "name": "Synthetic local upstream",
    "key": "DUMMY_NOT_A_SECRET",
    "chat": "http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1",
    "responses": "http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1",
    "baseAPI": "responses",
    "codexAsSent": true,
    "nativeCompaction": true,
    "models": ["blind-model-g"],
    "pickedFrom": ["blind-model-g"]
  }],
  "groups": [],
  "order": ["cpa"]
}
```

```json
{"port":18081,"lan":false,"updateEvery":0,"modelAPIs":{"cpa/blind-model-g":"chat"}}
```

向隔离网关的 `/v1/responses` 提交下列合成请求；所有标记、链接均为诊断数据：

```json
{
  "model": "cpa/blind-model-g",
  "stream": true,
  "reasoning": {"effort":"high"},
  "tools": [{"type":"function","name":"noop","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{}}}],
  "input": [
    {"type":"message","role":"user","content":"Find the evidence and use the tool."},
    {"type":"reasoning","id":"rs_diag","summary":[{"type":"summary_text","text":"UNIQUE_THINKING_X718"}]},
    {"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"UNIQUE_ASSISTANT_X718"}]},
    {"type":"web_search_call","id":"ws_diag","status":"completed","action":{
      "type":"search",
      "query":"UNIQUE_SEARCH_QUERY_X718",
      "queries":["UNIQUE_SEARCH_QUERY_X718"],
      "sources":[{"type":"url","url":"https://example.invalid/UNIQUE_SEARCH_RESULT_X718"}]
    }},
    {"type":"function_call","id":"fc_diag","call_id":"call_diag","name":"noop","arguments":"{}"},
    {"type":"function_call_output","call_id":"call_diag","output":"UNIQUE_TOOL_RESULT_X718"},
    {"type":"message","role":"user","content":"Continue with the evidence already found."}
  ]
}
```

mock 上游记录到的 Chat `messages`：

```json
[
  {"role":"user","content":"Find the evidence and use the tool."},
  {"role":"assistant","content":"UNIQUE_ASSISTANT_X718","tool_calls":[{"id":"call_diag","type":"function","function":{"name":"noop","arguments":"{}"}}]},
  {"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"call_diag","content":"UNIQUE_TOOL_RESULT_X718"},
  {"role":"user","content":"Continue with the evidence already found."}
]
```

| 输入标记 | Chat 上游中是否存在 |
|---|---|
| 搜索 query | **否** |
| 搜索来源 URL | **否** |
| 普通 assistant 文本 | 是，1 次 |
| function 工具结果 | 是 |
| reasoning summary | 否；仅记录此现象，不主张对所有上游无条件回填 reasoning |

网关正常产生 `response.completed`，因此仅检查 HTTP 200 / 普通工具往返不能发现这个历史转换缺口。

## 真实链路的合成对照

在现有 `cpa/blind-model-g` 路由发送两组互不相同的随机诊断码，没有发送真实会话：

1. 码仅放在历史 `web_search_call.action.query/sources`，要求从历史读回，不搜索、不猜测：模型返回 **`MISSING`**。
2. 另一码放在普通 `function_call_output`，要求读回：模型准确返回该码。

两次均 HTTP 200、1 次 `response.completed`、流式正文 delta 与最终完整正文一致。这证明读取历史信息存在差异，**不把该对照冒充长会话重复问题的完整因果验证**。

## 代码定位

版本 tag 对应 commit：`b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8`。

- [responses.go L495–505](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8/internal/gateway/responses.go#L495-L505)：先解析 `web_search_call` 为内部 Search，保存 query 和来源 URL。
- [responses.go L611](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8/internal/gateway/responses.go#L611)：调用 `searchRoundsBack()`。
- [responses.go L639–644](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8/internal/gateway/responses.go#L639-L644)：非 assistant 或没有 `claudeSigned` 时直接删除 Search parts：

```go
if m.Role != "assistant" || !slices.ContainsFunc(m.Parts, claudeSigned) {
    m.Parts = slices.DeleteFunc(slices.Clone(m.Parts), isSearch)
    // ...
    continue
}
```

另一个需要区分的边界：`searchRounds()` 在当前请求中把搜索结果正文放入 `results[i].Text` 并回填给模型，但对客户端发出的 KSearch 主要携带 query / hits。参见 [search.go L1414–1437](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8/internal/gateway/search.go#L1414-L1437)。因此“保住已有 query/URL”和“跨请求恢复完整搜索结果正文”是两个层次，后者可能需要额外的结果关联/存储机制；不能从 URL 凭空重建原始正文。

## 期望行为 / 建议验收

- 无 Claude signed thinking 的搜索历史，也应以协议合法的形式保留输入里已有的查询和来源；不要静默丢弃。
- 不生成缺少配对结果的孤立 tool call；不要破坏现有 Claude signed-thinking 路径。
- 如果需要完整结果正文，明确其保存与回放策略；若原请求没有该内容，不应编造。
- 回归测试不仅检查 parse 成功/200，还要断言 query、source URL 能到达最终 Chat 请求；加入跨请求历史回读与多轮搜索续接。
- native passthrough、普通 function 结果和不同上游的 reasoning 要求应分别处理。

## 相关但不同的讨论

- #2044：搜索记录从 Magpie **输出给客户端**；本报告关注记录作为下一次 **input 回传后被删除**。
- #4010：Claude signed thinking 跨搜索轮次的消息边界；本报告关注不满足该签名条件的普通搜索历史。
- #3206：工具声明在协议转换中丢失；本报告关注已经完成的工具历史。
